name: CHP Explorer Post (East Sacramento)
what_you_do: You can join an Explorer post for teens who want a law enforcement career. You get training and mentoring from CHP officers.
who_can_apply: The CHP lists 15 to 20 for Explorers; the East Sacramento post page snippet says ages 15 to 21.
how_to_apply: See the CHP Explorer post locator and contact the East Sacramento post.
notes: The CHP site blocked WebFetch (403) and a browser tab loaded blank, so ages come from search results and are unconfirmed. CHP has other posts.
